programme.title: Amour Aveugle
programme.desc: Un romancier aveugle et une femme mariée entament une liaison passionnée, entraînant un choix de vie.

programme.title: Middle Men
programme.desc: A l'heure des débuts d'Internet, un redoutable businessman lance le premier site pornographique payant.

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.7
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.5
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.4
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Infamous
programme.desc: Arielle, jeune serveuse, s'ennuie dans son travail dans sa petite ville de Floride. Un jour elle tombe amoureuse d'un criminel récemment sorti de prison mais encore en conditionnelle.

programme.title: Ma super ex
programme.desc: Gauche, Matt voit sa rencontre avec Jenny (qui est en fait G-Girl) comme un cadeau. Mais quand il décide de rompre, il se retrouve confronté à une super-héroïne super rancunière.

programme.title: Pour l'amour de Rose
programme.desc: Rose Newell est décoratrice d'intérieur à Los Angeles. En apprenant que son père s'est cassé la jambe, elle décide d'aller épauler ses parents dans leur exploitation de tulipes, tout en gérant à distance un chantier de décoration très important pour sa carrière.

programme.title: For Love or Money
programme.desc: Mark a une vie de rêve : il est sur le point de devenir multimillionnaire et d'épouser son amour de jeunesse, Connie. Mais les choses ne sont parfaites qu'en surface : Mark découvre par hasard que Connie ne l'aime pas et compte juste voler sa fortune une fois le mariage prononcé.

programme.title: Le Triangle Amoureux
programme.desc: Carl organise un week-end romantique de ski dans les Laurentides avec sa femme. Mais ce n'est pas la première fois qu'il se rend dans cette auberge : il y a passé de nombreux week-ends passionés avec son ex, Robyn, qui occupe toujours ses pensées...

programme.title: La liberté à tout prix
programme.desc: Allemagne de l'Est, 1984 : Frank Korbach se réjouit de fréquenter l'école d'art dramatique, tandis que son meilleur ami rebelle Thomas refuse de faire son service militaire. Avec l'aventureux mais naïf Alex, Thomas projette de faire une tentative désespérée de fuite vers l'Ouest. Sachant qu'il ne les reverra peut-être jamais, Frank accompagne Thomas et Alex à la frontière. Soudain, ils sont confrontés à une unité spéciale de la Stasi, la police secrète est-allemande. Bien que les garçons parviennent à éviter la capture, l'ancienne vie de Frank a disparu à jamais - il est maintenant devenu un fugitif. Le père de Frank, Kurt Korbach, est stupéfait par cette évasion. Kurt est un major de la Stasi, à l'insu de son fils. Convaincu que Frank est innocent, il persuade ses supérieurs que lui seul peut ramener son fils. Avec le suspect colonel Frey - une bombe à retardement prête à exploser - Kurt se met en route pour retrouver les garçons en fuite.

programme.title: Présumés coupables: souvenirs volés
programme.desc: Anna (Alexandra Neldel) reçoit un appel téléphonique de son nouveau partenaire commercial Philipp Rothkamm (Maximilian von Pufendorf) : Dans une université d'élite, une jeune femme (Emily Cox) affirme avoir été abusée sexuellement sous l'influence de gouttes de knock-out à une fête de la fraîcheur. Mais après un entretien personnel, ses doutes surgissent. Peu de temps après, la jeune femme se suicide.

programme.title: Marge d'Erreur
programme.desc: Rebecca (Anny Duperey), avocate, réalise que le jeune homme (Julien Crampon) qu'elle a disculpé après une brillante défense pourrait bien être le coupable du meurtre dont il est accusé, et qu'il prépare peut-être un autre crime....

programme.title: Le Noël du cœur
programme.desc: Après avoir gagné un prix de 50 000 dollars, un homme décide de rendre la pareille en achetant des cadeaux de Noël à des inconnus sous le pseudonyme de « Lucky the Elf ».

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: The New Captain Scarlet - Épisode 21: Situé en 2068, Captain Scarlet suit la "guerre psychologique" entre la Terre et les Mysterons, une race martienne qui possède un contrôle partiel sur la matière. Lorsqu'un malentendu pousse des astronautes humains à attaquer leur ville sur Mars, les Mysterons jurent de se venger et lancent une série de représailles contre la Terre.

programme.title: A Magic Puppy
programme.desc: Adam adore les films d'horreur. C'est une passion qu'il partage avec son amie Molly, qui est secrètement amoureuse de lui. A la suite d'un extraordinaire concours de circonstances, Adam transforme Ted, le petit ami de sa mère, en chien ! Adam et Molly n'auront que quelques jours pour rendre à Ted son aspect initial.

programme.title: Horatio, un Ami Extraordinaire
programme.desc: Depuis que son père est mort, 16 ans, Juliette, sa belle-mère et ses deux demi-frères luttent pour garder leur ranch. Mais Juliette pense qu'elle a un secret qui pourrait garder le ranch ouvert: son cheval, Horatio, peut parler!

programme.title: Bienvenue à Acapulco
programme.desc: Un développeur de jeux vidéo doit se rendre au nouveau mexique pour le travail mais se trompe d'avion et se retrouve au mexique. Les choses se gâtent alors une fois à acapulco…

programme.title: Being Light
programme.desc: Maxime, un jeune homme de 25 ans, débarque à Paris, mais souhaite rejoindre Justine, la femme qu'il aime, en Inde. Au bar de l'hôtel Raphaël, il fait la connaissance de Jack Lesterhoof, un riche homme d'affaires. Maxime accepte. Les deux hommes deviennent bientôt amis. Jack décide de faire un break, de rompre avec la routine et d'accompagner Maxime en Inde.

programme.title: Ricky Bobby: Roi Du Circuit
programme.desc: Il court, il court, le Ricky Bobby. Ricky Bobby du Nascar ici. Ricky Bobby du Nascar par là. Toujours plus vite il va. Sur les podiums victorieux il s'asseoit. Mais tant va le succès qu'à la fin, Ricky Bobby n'est plus ni diva ni divin. Et contre ses démons se bat. Pour retrouver ses vroums vroums d'émois...

programme.title: Sex Tape
programme.desc: Jay et Annie sont mariés depuis dix ans et sont parents de deux enfants. Depuis quelques années pourtant, leur passion amoureuse s'est quelque peu érodée. Pour ranimer leur vie de couple devenue trop fade, les deux époux sont déterminés à la pimenter avec une idée très excitante. En l'absence des enfants, ils décident un soir de filmer leurs ébats érotiques avec leur tablette numérique. Mais au lendemain de leur nuit torride, Jay et Annie découvrent que la vidéo intime a malencontreusement été envoyée à leur entourage personnel et professionnel. Paniqué, le couple est prêt à tout pour récupérer et faire disparaître le film chez tous les destinataires...

programme.title: Jumping The Broom
programme.desc: Deux familles afro-américaines provenant de milieux socio-économiques très différents sont réunies lors d'un mariage à Martha's Vineyard.

programme.title: Think Like A Man Too
programme.desc: Les couples sont de retour pour un mariage à Las Vegas, mais ce qui devait être un week-end romantique vire en cauchemar lorsque leurs diverses mésaventures les amènent dans des situations compromettantes, qui menacent de faire tomber à l'eau le mariage.

programme.title: Détestables Nous
programme.desc: Trois amis d'enfance organisent un complot afin de trouver une copine pour Barry, leur ami d'enfance insupportable, vulgaire et désagréable. Leur plan se retourne contre eux quand sa nouvelle petite amie se révèle tout aussi détestable que lui.

programme.title: Amateur night
programme.desc: Guy carter veut être un mari et un papa modèle. Mais malgré ses efforts, ce jeune architecte ne trouve aucun travail et se voit contraint d'accepter un emploi de chauffeur. Malheureusement...

programme.title: Deathgasm
programme.desc: Deux geeks chevelus s'ennuient ferme dans leur bled paumé et décident de créer leur propre groupe de metal. Mais une mystérieuse partition sur laquelle ils ont mis la main va briser cette relative quiétude : quelques notes jouées suffisent à déchainer les enfers sur leur petite ville.

programme.title: En chantier, Monsieur Tanner !
programme.desc: Monsieur Tanner, reporter animalier, hérite d'un manoir. Sur place, il constate que la bâtisse est en mauvais état et que des travaux avaient commencé. Paul décide de poursuivre la rénovation.

programme.title: Mauvaise connexion!
programme.desc: Un couple usé par le temps, Dan et Janice Dewerson, décide de s'organiser un week-end en amoureux en même temps qu'une " détox numérique ". Mais ce qui commence comme un séjour romantique et parfait va vite tourner à la catastrophe.

programme.title: Les Impitoyables
programme.desc: Un prêtre et son frère jumeau se relaient pour défendre une petite ville contre le gang vicieux des Clayton.

programme.title: On l'appelle Trinita
programme.desc: Un tireur paresseux et peu orthodoxe et son frère corpulent et voleur de chevaux défendent une colonie mormone contre un major accapareur de terres, un bandit mexicain et leurs hommes de main.

programme.title: Le Géant de Métropolis
programme.desc: Muscleman Ohro se rend dans la capitale pécheresse de l'Atlantide pour réprimander son impiété et son orgueil, et s'engage dans la bataille contre son seigneur maléfique Yoh-tar et ses plans hideux de super-science.

programme.title: Je vais... je tire... et je reviens
programme.desc: Un gang dérobe une cargaison d'or dans un train. Un soi-disant chasseur de primes est envoyé à la recherche des voleurs et décide de les laisser le conduire jusqu'à l'or.

programme.title: Mallory 'M' comme la mort
programme.desc: Il y a douze ans, Sartana a fait accuser son frère Johnny de meurtre et lui a volé sa petite amie. Devenu le chef incontesté de la ville et choyé par sa mère possessive, Sartana semble en sécurité - jusqu'à ce que, sa peine purgée, Johnny revienne en ville.

programme.title: Je Suis Vivant !
programme.desc: A Prague, le corps de Gregory Moore, un journaliste américain, est retrouvé dans un parc. Il est déclaré mort à la morgue, mais il est victime d'une machination. En réalité il a été plongé dans un état de catalepsie et apparaît comme décédé aux yeux de la science. Or, son esprit fonctionne encore.

programme.title: Sacrifices
programme.desc: Un groupe d'Américains atterit au Mexique pour un voyage éducatif organisé par le père O'Sullivan. Le programme prévoit non seulement la visite guidée des temples aztèques et mayas, mais aussi une découverte des rites sanguinaires apparemment reconstitués par les tribus d'Oaxaca. Mais peu à peu, les spectateurs s'aperçoivent que les scènes meurtrières sont plus vrais que nature.

programme.title: Alien Convergence
programme.desc: Un groupe d'anciens militaires blessés au combat s'entraîne sur un projet de casque neurologique permettant de contrôler les avions de chasse uniquement par la pensée. Pendant un de leurs tests, plusieurs explosions successives ont lieu sur différents sites. Les anciens militaires décident de se remettre au service de l'armée pour éradiquer des aliens qui paralysent le système nerveux des pilotes.

programme.title: White Settlers
programme.desc: C'est la première nuit d'Ed et Sarah dans leur nouvelle maison : une ferme isolée à la frontière de l'Ecosse. Alors qu'ils pensaient échapper au stress de leur vie londonienne, le sommeil de Sarah est troublé par des bruits suspects. Leur nouvelle vie se transforme en cauchemar lorsque le couple part faire des investigations dans les bois à la nuit tombée. Ils réalisent alors qu'ils ne sont pas ici chez eux et encore moins les bienvenus.

programme.title: Yeti
programme.desc: Un avion s'écrase dans les montagnes de l'Himalaya. Pris au piège au milieu des falaises abruptes, les rescapés s'organisent pour leur survie. Ils sont attaqués par une créature affamée et assoiffée de sang: un abominable homme des neiges qui aime la chair humaine.

programme.title: Sea Fever
programme.desc: Dans le cadre de ses études, Siobhán, étudiante en biologie marine, doit passer une semaine sur un vieux chalutier. Peu de temps après leur départ en mer, une forme de vie inconnue enserre le navire, l'immobilisant au beau milieu de l'Atlantique.

programme.title: Les dieux des profondeurs
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une mission audacieuse conduit une équipe de sous-marin en eaux profondes dans une mystérieuse ouverture au fond de l'océan, ils découvrent un monde sous-marin perdu et réveillent son ancienne race d'êtres d'un autre monde...

programme.title: Last survivors
programme.desc: Au lendemain d'un événement apocalyptique qui a contraint les gens à un isolement extrême. Un père et son fils rencontrent une étrangère qui menace de détruire l'utopie qu'ils ont construite.

programme.title: Genesis
programme.desc: Dans une société post-apocalyptique vivant sous terre pour se protéger de la pollution, la principale préoccupation est de se procurer suffisamment de nourriture et de trouver d'autres survivants. Un androïde résistant à la pollution doté d'une I.A. a été développé pour l'y aider

programme.title: Parallel minds
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche, un laboratoire à la pointe de l'Intelligence Artificielle, a mis au point une lentille de contact révolutionnaire, RED EYE 2, capable d'enregistrer ce que l'œil peut voir et de faire resurgir des souvenirs enfouis.

programme.title: Le Chemin du passé
programme.desc: Un scientifique disparaît mystérieusement lors d'un déplacement professionnel. Plusieurs années après, son fils et son grand-père vont faire une étonnante découverte au sujet de cette disparition...

programme.title: My All American
programme.desc: L'histoire vraie de Freddie Steinmark, star du football dans son collège, qui se voit diagnostiquer un cancer après avoir remporté le titre national de 1969.

programme.title: 3 secondes
programme.desc: En 1972 aux JO de Munich, l'équipe de basket-ball de l'Union soviétique joue la finale face aux Etats-Unis. Les 3 dernières secondes de ce match vont propulser l'équipe soviétique dans la légende.

programme.title: Jack Strong
programme.desc: L'espion polonais le plus spectaculaire de l'époque de la guerre froide, le colonel Ryszard Kuklinski, informe les Américains des plus grands secrets du bloc communiste face à l'imminence de la loi martiale.

programme.title: Bad Samaritan
programme.desc: Des cambrioleurs tombent sur une femme retenue en captivité dans une maison qu'ils avaient l'intention de voler.

programme.title: 7th Floor
programme.desc: Un père se lance dans une recherche désespérée pour retrouver ses enfants qui ont disparu alors qu'ils descendaient les escaliers de leur appartement au septième étage.

programme.title: Elaine, portée disparue
programme.desc: Plongez dans un thriller palpitant et mystérieux. Une intrigue captivante où la disparition d'Elaine Dawson fait peser les soupçons sur le célèbre avocat Marc Reeve. Un polar intense de vérité et de mensonge.

programme.title: In Search of Darkness
programme.desc: Plongez dans l'horreur des années 80 avec cette conclusion gargantuesque qui s'attaque à l'âge d'or de la VHS et des vidéoclubs, dresse les portraits d'artistes et artisans incontournables et aborde de nombreuses pépites oubliées d'un cinéma imaginatif, sanglant, expérimental, indispensable…

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: Après avoir été ressuscité par une entité sinistre, Art le Clown revient dans la ville de Miles County où il prend pour cible une adolescente et son jeune frère le soir d'Halloween.

programme.title: In Search of Darkness
programme.desc: Plongez dans l'horreur des années 80 avec cette conclusion gargantuesque qui s'attaque à l'âge d'or de la VHS et des vidéoclubs, dresse les portraits d'artistes et artisans incontournables et aborde de nombreuses pépites oubliées d'un cinéma imaginatif, sanglant, expérimental, indispensable…

programme.title: Scanners
programme.desc: Une société cherche à regrouper les Scanners, des médiums aux pouvoirs surnaturels. Elle recrute un jeune médium pour détecter tous les Scanners qui lui sont opposés. Il va découvrir les aspects cachés de cette périlleuse mission.

programme.title: In Search of Darkness
programme.desc: Plongez dans l'horreur des années 80 avec cette conclusion gargantuesque qui s'attaque à l'âge d'or de la VHS et des vidéoclubs, dresse les portraits d'artistes et artisans incontournables et aborde de nombreuses pépites oubliées d'un cinéma imaginatif, sanglant, expérimental, indispensable…

programme.title: Contracted Phase II
programme.desc: Infecté par un virus, un homme lutte pour empêcher lépidémie de se propager.

programme.title: La Malédiction des profondeurs et Rottweiler
programme.desc: La Malédiction des profondeurs et Rottweiler

programme.title: Arctic Armageddon
programme.desc: Les températures chutent et plongent le monde dans un chaos glacial. Résistant aux conditions les plus extrêmes, le sous marin USS 598 Dallas et son équipage vont alors tenter l'impossible.

programme.title: War Of Apes
programme.desc: Pour sauver l'humanité, un gigantesque singe et son ennemi mécanique, Mecha Ape MkII, s'allient.

programme.title: Harcelés
programme.desc: Pour Chris et Lisa, emménager dans leur maison de Lakeview Terrace est un rêve devenu réalité. Pourtant, rapidement, les deux jeunes gens deviennent la cible de leur voisin, qui désapprouve leur relation interraciale. Cet homme strict et austère, père célibataire et policier, s'est autoproclamé responsable de la sécurité du quartier.

programme.title: L'experience Interdite – Flatliners
programme.desc: Pour découvrir ce qu'il se passe après la mort, cinq étudiants en médecine se lancent dans une expérience audacieuse et dangereuse : se provoquer volontairement des arrêts cardiaques pendant de courtes périodes afin de vivre des expériences de mort imminente (EMI). En allant de plus en plus loin dans leurs expérimentations, ils vont devoir affronter non seulement leur part d'ombre et leur passé, mais plus effrayant encore, des phénomènes étranges liés au fait qu'ils sont revenus de l'au-delà…

programme.title: Flic de Haut Vol
programme.desc: Un cambrioleur se fait passer pour un flic pour récupérer un diamant volé.

programme.title: Art Of Steal
programme.desc: Deux frères spécialisés dans le vol d'oeuvres d'art décident d'orchestrer un dernier cambriolage. Mais les choses ne se passent pas tout à fait comme prévu...

programme.title: Carré blanc
programme.desc: Philippe vit dans un monde régi par un système de castes. Ceux qui jouent correctement le « jeu » accèdent à des positions plus élevées et acquièrent davantage de pouvoir. Philippe joue bien le jeu, mais sa femme souhaite qu'il revienne à la réalité. C'est une histoire d'amour après le mariage.

programme.title: House of Boys
programme.desc: Amsterdam, 1984, Frank a 18 ans et décide de quitter le domicile familial pour s'émanciper et vivre sa vie comme il l'entend. Pour survivre, Il devient alors danseur dans le club de strip-tease " House of Boys ".

programme.title: Jeux de gangs
programme.desc: Deux jeunes filles aisées de banlieue se heurtent à la culture des gangs latinos de l'Est de Los Angeles.

programme.title: Altamira
programme.desc: 1878, près de Santander. Marcelino Sanz, un paléontologue amateur, découvre dans une grotte des peintures rupestres. Mais sa découverte agite le clergé Monseigneur tente de manipuler sa femme, Conchita, et sa fille, en tentant de les éloigner de l'influence rationaliste de Marcelino.

programme.title: Hours
programme.desc: Eté 2005. L'ouragan Katrina dévaste la Nouvelle-Orléans. Nolan Hayes emmène aux urgences son épouse enceinte. Sa vie bascule lorsqu'il apprend son décès et découvre son enfant prématuré. Nolan se retrouve seul et doit veiller sur sa fille, maintenue en vie dans une couveuse...

programme.title: Trigger point
programme.desc: Nicolas Shaw, un agent de la CIA à la retraite, souffrant de perte de mémoire, revient dans le monde de l'espionnage suite à la disparition mystérieuse d'une amie proche, ex-collègue.

programme.title: Zero Tolerance
programme.desc: Un ancien agent paramilitaire recherche les assassins de sa fille à Bangkok. Il fait un carnage pour se venger et se faire justice.

programme.title: No Way Back
programme.desc: Dans un affrontement entre des hommes du FBI et une équipe néo-nazie, le fils du gangster Serlano meurt. Il kidnappe le fils d'un agent pour proposer un échange à la police et se venger d'un chef de la mafia, prétendument responsable du meurtre.

programme.title: Disturbing The Peace
programme.desc: Jim Dillon, un ancien Texas Ranger hanté par son passé, est devenu le Marchal d'une petite ville tranquille. Mais alors qu'un dangereux gang de motard envahit les rues, il n'a plus d'autre choix que de reprendre les armes.

programme.title: Sacrifice
programme.desc: Obsédé par la mort récente de sa femme et de sa fille, John Hebron tente de se raccrocher à sa carrière de policier entre deux verres de whisky. Venu chercher conseil auprès du père Porter, dont l'église vient d'être saccagée...

programme.desc: Eight London drag queens tell their stories in this striking new documentary. Contrasting the glamour, fun and witty humour you'd expect from London drag with personal stories of growing up and the unrelenting resilience drag gives them to face life. programme.title: Nuts about Squirrels
programme.desc: Squirrels have conquered tundra, deserts, forests and more, developing ingenious life skills along the way, from stashing nuts to fighting snakes.

programme.title: Seals
programme.desc: Life is rarely easy for seals, and yet all over the world they consistently rise to the challenge – and always have fun doing it.

programme.title: Wild Waters
programme.desc: From the highest mountain to the lowest valley, rivers and streams are freshwater highways, de-livering essential life blood to all kinds of wildlife. From some of the most iconic species like the otter and the trout, to the unfamiliar and elusive, like the delicate harvest mouse. Life on these freshwater freeways can be tough, and for many it's a constant battle just to stay alive. Take a break from the oceans and turn to the rivers and streams, home to the real wild waters of the nat-ural world.

programme.title: Colours of Nature
programme.desc: From subtle to shocking, colour enhances the beauty of the natural world. Colour is a language to most living things, whether as a warning, camouflage or a come on. But there's more to colour than just pigment. Colours define how many animals behave, how they mate and how they inter-act with one another. For us the beautiful and varied shades of the animal kingdom form a spec-tacular kaleidoscope of colours. With all the diversity in the world, sit back and enjoy all the col-ours of the animal kingdom.

programme.title: Defending the Family
programme.desc: In the animal kingdom the desire to breed and defend young sits above all else, and every creature deploys its own unique strategies to get the job done. Some fight for their own with lethal jaws, whilst others get in help, making use of neighbourhood bodyguards for hire. Some rely on close friends to help them out and others choose to isolate themselves in a fortress instead. Whatever their plan for a safe home, one thing's for sure - animals will stop at nothing to defend their families.

programme.title: Heroes Of The Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: Hunting has been a long-standing cultural tradition in the North Eastern India for long. But with the shirking of the forests and endangering of the wildlife, hunting has become unsustainable. But it is not that this has stopped hunting.

programme.title: Pythons and the Exotic Pet Trade
programme.desc: For those of us that long to escape the rat race the pull of the wild can be strong. Whether we're risking our lives with extreme sports, following our animal passions or just taking a walk on the wild side, the natural world calls to us. What's more, the power of nature tests our limits, opens our eyes and heals our hearts in equal measure. So why try to resist such a beautiful, exciting and enlightening siren song? Perhaps there's nothing better for us humans than to follow the pull of the wild.

programme.title: Fight for Territory
programme.desc: Biological instinct is driven by three things: the desire to stay alive, to find food and to breed. But to do all these things, animals first need a home. Out in the wilderness a safe place to call home can be the difference between life and death. A place to secure meals, raise their families and hide from danger. Ideal spots are in short supply and well worth fighting for! From lion scraps to insect warfare, these conflicts can provide us with the most remarkable spectacles in the animal kingdom.

programme.title: Billion Dollar Fish
programme.desc: They are virtually unchanged from their ancestors, who swam in ancient rivers when the dinosaurs still ruled the planet. Their unfertilised eggs became black gold, served in only the most expensive restaurants as caviar. This ancient giant is the Beluga Sturgeon, considered by some to be the largest freshwater fish in the world. Sturgeons are now at the very edge of extinction because of the exclusive market for their eggs, but only the eggs can allow the species to live. Paradoxically, the desire for caviar may now be the only chance they have for their future existence.

programme.title: Lobsters
programme.desc: The knights of the deep are on the move almost no part of their bodies is without armor. Like medieval warriors, these fighters are well armed – not with sword and shield, but with scissors and forceps and defensive armor that is covered with spikes and hooks. And even though they are well protected and have an uncanny awareness of their surroundings, many of these proud knights will face a gloomy destiny. Many of them will end upon a plate. Gourmets all over the world are in love with these famous crustaceans: lobsters! For marine biologists lobsters are similarly fascinating: as research objects. We are on their trail in Cape Breton, an island in the northern Atlantic and part of the Canadian province Nova Scotia, where one of the largest populations of lobsters has its home.

programme.title: Vicious Beauties
programme.sub-title: The secret World of the Jelly Fish
programme.desc: Watching the graceful movement of these gelatinous animals is almost hypnotic. Although their bodies are 98% water, jellyfish are deceptively clever and dangerous. But where do these primordial creatures come from? How do they reproduce and how long do they live?

programme.title: Predators of a Different Kind
programme.sub-title: In the World of the Unknown Sharks
programme.desc: With the aid of modern technology, reveal the unknown behaviour of some unusual species of shark: lemon sharks and their white-tip reef counterparts. Our film trip begins on the Bahamas. To be more precise: in the turquoise-blue waters of the Grand Bahama Bank, in an exactly fixed location. In the spring, 70 – 80 pregnant lemon sharks arrive here. This huge shark population was first discovered just a few years ago by shark researcher, Professor Sam Gruber. Many of the females are tired and rest on the seabed. Pregnant tiger sharks swim in the midst of this group. Without any protection whatsoever, our cameramen shoot their footage, surrounded by sharks and succeed in capturing images hitherto unseen. We continue our journey to Gainesville, Florida, to meet Gordon Hubbell, the leading shark denture expert with the world's largest shark denture collection. He knows everything about the evolutionary history of the lemon sharks, in addition to those of the white-tip reef variety off Cocos Island, Costa Rica. Here, we encounter large schools of fish, unprecedented numbers of stingrays, as well as hammerhead sharks. However, it is the white-tip reek sharks that make the biggest impression. Their performance begins late at night. Marauding, they patrol in large groups through the reefs and hunt everything that moves. Scales and dead prey fish float above the reef – a welcoming change of diet for the ubiquitous barracudas.

programme.title: Giants of Fortune
programme.desc: In the little Filipino village of Oslob on the Cebu Island, people suffer from typhoons and overfishing. Until the world's biggest fish and the Internet change everything.Fisherman Zosimo's dearest wish is for his children to graduate from high school one day. Yet the chance that this wish will come true is tiny, since at times Zosimo doesn't even manage to feed the family. Typhoons and overfishing make the lives of Oslob fishermen difficult.

programme.desc: Our journeys take us all around the world from Patagonia to the USA, from Greenland to South Africa and from Cambodia to Australia and leads us to the most fascinating places where landscapes animals and humans are the main focus of our documentaries. programme.desc: It appears winter is finally coming to an end and Raspberry is planning a big fashion show to display her spring line. Every time the girls come to rehearse, they must comically dodge jets of fruit juice from the out-of-control fountain-the Berrykins are still working out the bugs.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is excitedly making their way through the berry batch in search of the elusive Wanderberry. It is to be the dessert at the BerryFest Feast. Everyone is milling about searching for it on their own when Blueberry points out that the rules say the BerryFest Princess is in charge of the search. The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves
programme.desc: Overhearing Blueberry reading a story to the baby Berrykins about the scary Galumphalot, Orange is uncharacteristically shaken. She determines she doesn't want anything scary around her, just relaxation. But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Where, Oh, Where Has Our Blueberry Gone?
programme.desc: Blueberry has become obsessed with the mystery book detective heroine, Patti Persimmon. She decorates her store with Patti posters and rearranges her shelves to make room for all the Patti books she's ordered. Blueberry begins to neglect outings with her friends and even goes so far as to dress like her idol just to emulate her. She then starts looking for cases to solve around town.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While in the midst of a cake decorating demonstration at the café, the girls are uncharacteristically interrupted by an excited Princess Berrykin. She announces the Berrykins have decided to revive the old tradition of the Berry Bitty Buggy Derby. While the girls enthusiastically recount the stories they've heard about it and ask the Princess questions, Blueberry, carrying enough books to block her view, comes through the door and unknowingly interrupts the Princess.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The grove around Berry Bitty City is abuzz with activity. The Berrykins are using their sparkles to harvest berries, Berrykin Bloom is in his garden spraying flowers with a special solution to make them larger, and Raspberry is nearby gathering flower petals to make perfume. The wind starts to blow and picks up some of the sparkles. The sparkles float along the wind and get combined with some of Berrykin Bloom's solution.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are all gathered at the café. Strawberry is experimenting making applesauce from scratch with a mallet (and making a mess) while the rest busily make their own wrapping paper and bows for the annual gift exchange they hold in celebration of First Frost. Mr. Longface stops by and Strawberry offers him some fresh applesauce but he declines, as he doesn't care for it. He's only there for some tea and, being that he's new in town, doesn't know what the group is up to.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Raspberry is distraught when she suspects her friends have copied her design on her lantern for the "Glimmerberry Gathering".

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While sipping cider in Strawberry's café, the girls muse about how they cannot wait for winter to arrive. They list the various traditions they love about the season but the one they all agree on is the Glimmerberry Ball. Strawberry mentions that she doesn't think the café can hold the party this year because of how the town has grown. The girls decide to split up and search for a new location.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: After returning to the café after a walk with her pets, Strawberry is met by Mr. Longface. He's been waiting for her so that they can get started making treats and decorating for Sadiebug's and Kadiebug's party that afternoon. But Custard and Pupcake have enjoyed their time outside so much that they want to continue playing.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Finding she has some free time one morning, Strawberry visits Berrykin Bloom who is filled with excitement over his new crop of Berry Bitty fruits and vegetables his garden has never grown so much produce! He can't wait to share his new crop (the perfect bitty size) with Berry Bitty City, so Strawberry volunteers to help him transport the produce to Orange's General Store.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot. The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely. The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: Dream Chasers

programme.title: Legacy, Vehicle and Mechs

Nya digitizes Jay and uploads him into Zane's mind. Jay reviews memories of the Ninja's various motorcycles, mechs and planes in order to solve the vehicle-themed puzzle.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: Transformers

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: Inferno uses his decepticon "half" to bait Megatron.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: Tigatron finds a floating island and chooses a peaceful life there.

programme.title: Transformers

programme.title: Transformers

programme.desc: The children learn more about the history of the minicons and the war.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Royal Drum: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Kow-Tow, We Won't Bow: Smurfette leads the Smurflings on a nature hike, but Puppy gets too far ahead and they chase him into the land of the Wartmongers. King Bullrush captures them in bubbles and imprisons them. A group of rebels rescue the Smurflings and they escape on the back of Puppy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf On The Wild Side, Part I: What, or who, is that strange being in the forest? It looks vaguely like a Smurf, but it chatters away like the squirrel that seems to be accompanying it… And why is Papa Smurf talking about the Lost Smurfling?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Snappy's Puppet: Snappy has a new trick: he frightens everybody, or tries to, with his hand-puppet dragon. But it gets, shall we say, out of hand when Papa Smurf's magic liquid falls on the puppet and it comes alive. Alive and kicking, what's more, endangering Snappy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - No Smurf Is An Island: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Crooner Smurf: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Baby Smurf Is Missing: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Smurfing Out Of Time: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Memory Melon: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf For Denisa: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Poltersmurf: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Greedy And The Porridge Pot: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Most Unsmurfy Games: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Noble Stag: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: Panic Unbearable Legend About Insects
programme.desc: Once there was a girl called Anya who was very scared of insects! One day Anya's mother asked her to help around the house but in everything she did, Anya was haunted by spiders and all kinds of midges! She was on the edge of despair when her little brother proved to her, that little crumbs can't be of any danger to giants like children!

programme.title: Happy New Year… Again!
programme.desc: Masha decides celebrating New Year once is not enough and goes to mysterious China, where dragons dance, gardens bloom and many, many more interesting things are happening!

programme.title: Like Cat And Mouse
programme.desc: Alert! Bear's fridge is in danger! Someone has burst into his house to stay for life…but the Bear is ready for everything to defend his stocks! He calls for a savior, but in reality it turns to be a new intriguing story full of unexpected discoveries which leads Masha to some peculiar conclusions!

programme.title: At Your Service
programme.desc: The technologies some time can teach us a human lesson like in this story about two robots. One of them was presented to Masha for her birthday and the other one was made by the Bear to help him around, but tried to become the boss. Everything turned into great mess and only an unexpectedly awakened feeling between two robots put everything in its place.

programme.title: All You Need is a Goal
programme.desc: The ball is on the field, the players are in the field, the Bear in the chair is rooting for his favorite team. But Masha got bored in anticipation of a goal. Why wait when there is a team in the yard, and everyone needs a goal so much!

programme.title: Bon Appétit
programme.desc: Panda- the Bear's distant relative pays one more visit to the Bear. They start making Chinese dump-lings, but then Masha appears, with her own methods of cooking. And a simple cooking turns into a culinary master class with butterflies!

programme.title: Once In A Year
programme.desc: The Bear has his birthday party. All animals come to his place to congratulate him and give some presents. Seeing this Masha decides to prepare for her own birthday so none of the animals wouldn't have a chance to forget about her party and the list of presents.The Bear has his birthday party. All animals come to his place to congratulate him and give some presents. Seeing this Masha decides to prepare for her own birthday so none of the animals wouldn't have a chance to forget about her party and the list of presents.

programme.title: Prances With Wolves
programme.desc: The Wolves that live in the forest come with a plan to kidnap Masha and demand the Bear to pay a ransom. However the Bear is pleased to find Masha gone and he does not rush the events. Meanwhile Masha turns the Wolves' lives into a hell and they end up paying the ransom to the Bear just to get rid of her once and for all.

programme.title: Around the world in one day
programme.desc: The Bear is preparing to go on a world trip, but a last minute accident makes him panic. In the meantime, Masha knows the best way to prepare for the trip and shares it with the Bear.

programme.title: Princess and the Beast
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: Tee For Three
programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Masha is again playing mother and daughter with Rosie. But this time an honest lot distributed the roles. Now it's Masha's turn to put on her cap and get in the stroller. Will Rosie endure mother's everyday life?

programme.title: Terrible Power
programme.desc: The Female Bear presents Masha with a glamour magazine and now the Bear shall transform his house into a beauty salon. Get ready to learn a lesson that everything should be done with a sense of proportion, especially when it comes to beauty.

programme.title: All the world's a stage
programme.desc: The best remedy for boredom is a good game. And a good play is even better. That is exactly what our friends decided. It's just not so easy to agree on what kind of play to stage..

programme.title: The Tops and the Roots
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Ali Baba
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Tom Thumb
programme.desc: This is a story about the small but brave boy. The moral of the story is that no matter how big and tall you are, you should not offend the little ones. It may happen so that you will meet some tom thumb boy, who will beat any “giant”.

programme.title: Wee Little Havroshechka
programme.desc: There lived a woman who had three daughters - two of her own and the stepdaughter called Wee Little Havroshechka. She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

programme.title: Quartet Plus
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Tour de Forest
programme.desc: Himalayan Bear is once again competing with Bear! This time they have arranged a bike race, but something doesn't smell right: Himalayan Bear intends on cheating to win! Good thing Masha stands as a guardian of justice and always comes to a friend's aid!

programme.title: What's Inside?
programme.desc: In this episode, Masha decides to figure out how the objects surrounding her are arranged. And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. ""What is inside such seemingly simple objects surrounding us? How are the mechanisms that we use every day arranged? Maybe they work with the help of magic? Or maybe each system has a certain order?

programme.title: Try, Try Again
programme.desc: A van with Monkeys arrived at the Bear's house. They invite everyone to test themselves with the help of an attraction - a power meter. The Bear is confident that he will easily win the main prize. But things didn't go according to plan. And now the main strongman of the forest cannot do without the help of his friends.

programme.title: Princess and the Beast
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: First Day Of School
programme.desc: With the beginning of September, Masha, like all the children wants to go to school and asks the Bear to make her one. Overwhelmed with enthu-siasm, the Bear completes the task and the next day Masha sits at a brand new desk and tries to act as an attentive student but ends up bringing the Bear to absolute madness.

programme.title: Fishy story
programme.desc: Summer is a time of rest and miracles. How nice is just to sit on the river bank with your best friends! However, everything is not so simple in our story. The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

programme.title: Don't Wake Till Spring!
programme.desc: The autumn has arrived. The Bear prepares for his winter bedtime by barricading himself from Masha inside the house. But the little girl manages to find her way indoors and causes yet another mess by awakening a whole swarm of bees. But all her games eventually stop and when the Bear cooks some porridge to feed the child, he discovers her fallen asleep.

programme.title: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: At first time in her life Masha is frightened in earnest, however this creepy story shook up the whole forest and now hardly anyone can stay away from these strange scenes! And what would you do if your own pillow and blanket turn into real ghosts?! A real ghost story, oh yeah!

programme.title: The Very Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! That's how the story goes… The Bear still hopes to win the heart of the female Bear. He finds an ancient gondola at the bottom of the forest lake. The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.title: Time To Ride My Pony
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.title: The Grand Piano Lesson
programme.desc: The bear finds a beautiful black piano in the forest. He happily takes it home, fixes and tunes it and begins to play some music. Masha couldn't help staying away from this lovely instrument. She decides to become a world famous pianist, she asks the Bear to teach her how to play the piano.

programme.title: Arts and Crafts Day
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: The Foundling
programme.desc: Occasionally Masha finds an egg, from which a penguin hatches. The Bear has to take double care now. He cooks special dishes and builds mini aqua park for little penguin and Masha. Finally the Bear figures out that the penguin will be happy only in suitable weather conditions and send the penguin Antarctica on a little plane.

programme.title: See You Later
programme.desc: This day will change Bear's life forever. To everyone's surprise, Masha has suddenly grown up, getting all the forest dwellers shocked by her exceptionally good behavior. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, which really upsets the Bear and others.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: We Come In Peace!
programme.desc: In the courtyard of the Bear's house a spaceship makes an emergency landing. The aliens need to urgently replenish their supplies and return home. Only on the ground everything is arranged differently than at home. Masha and Mishka will help them to understand what's what, fix the ship and go back to home.

programme.title: Scary Story About Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Are you sure that you really like spooky stories? What if this kind of story will get you really thrilled? Listen to one classic story and don't say that you are not shocked after all!

programme.title: Soul Freezing Tale Of Grim Forest And Tiny Timid Bug
programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Terrible Truth About Those Who Are Afraid To Be Little
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Bloodcurdling Saga About Joyful Event
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Grim Parable About Superstitious Girl
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You'll see…

programme.title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Insight With Haslinda Amin
programme.desc: In a volatile and unpredictable world, the show will be the definitive guide for the global news audience to get the complete picture on the biggest story of the day. With news making executives, officials and thought-leaders from the world of business, politics and academia we will explore a story through probing interviews and nuanced conversations. The hour of programming will also highlight the most relevant stories from India which is currently one of the hottest investment destinations, but also has compelling stories that play into the Bloomberg's priority issues such as Climate change, Diversity and Technological innovation.

programme.title: Bloomberg The Opening Trade

programme.title: The Infinite Explorer With Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Hannah Fry explores how Iceland's geology shapes its culture she meets scientists studying lava flows and geothermal power, and travels ancient Viking trails.

programme.title: The Infinite Explorer With Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Professor Hannah Fry sets off on a global adventure, not just to see the world but to decode it Hannah seeks out local voices and quirks of history and geography that reveal what makes each place truly unique.

programme.title: The Infinite Explorer with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Hannah Fry travels to Spain to decode its history and culture she learns about the rhythms of flamenco, a mountain whistle language and the hidden symbolism in its urban planning.

programme.title: The Rise of America's ICE Towns
programme.desc: Small towns are at the center of President Donald Trump's mass deportation campaign, spearheaded by ICE in one rural New Mexico county, officials are grappling with what it means to be an ICE town.

programme.title: The Growing Toll of America's Booming Kratom Industry

programme.title: Leaders with Francine Lacqua: Alexander Stubb,

programme.title: LEADERS With Francine Lacqua

programme.title: LEADERS With Francine Lacqua

programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression.
